children: Polymarket's "India" option in the "Who wins the coin toss" submarket for the T20 Women's Asia Cup India vs. Sri Lanka event surged from 50.5% an hour earlier to 91%, according to Catcher Predict monitoring. The move marked a 40.5 percentage point swing, and the source said related breaking news may have affected the market.

title: Polymarket India Coin Toss Odds Jump to 91% in Women's Asia Cup Market
